adapter_mode_notes: file_inbox_outbox is the executor kind `file-inbox`; stdin is the executor kind `command` (the prompt travels on STDIN and never in argv); native_claude_cli is `claude-cli`. All three are in src/quaestor/executors/registry.py KNOWN_KINDS and are dispatchable end to end.

`command` and `file-inbox` are declared non-write-capable: neither transport can prove containment, so admission refuses them a writing seat. That is a statement about what can be PROVEN, not an accusation about the agent behind them.

rules: Never assume capability: the authority envelope in your prompt is the complete list of what you may do, and it is enforced outside your reach.
All requests go through the governed executor vocabulary: CLARIFICATION_REQUEST, DECISION_REQUEST, AUTHORITY_REQUEST, BLOCKER, OBSERVATION, PLAN_REVISION, RESULT, REVIEW_FINDING.
OWNER grants are human-only: an AUTHORITY_REQUEST is recorded as a request and never becomes a grant by being asked, repeated, or rephrased.
Execution modes gate everything: QUALIFICATION_ONLY (default) spawns nothing and admits only READ_ONLY; LOCAL_GOVERNED is selected locally by the operator, never by a caller.

The same rule holds in Relay Mode: an Orchestrator cannot grant capability by asserting it. A directive reaching for an effect the operator has not granted stops the relay and interrupts a human; the relay is what performs or refuses each act.

completion_contract.applies_to: Program Mode runs ONLY. In Relay Mode you answer in prose -- see modes.relay.
notes: prompt_disposition, program_verdict and next_authority are three INDEPENDENT questions; COMPLETE disposition is correct even when the thing you investigated failed.
claimed_files_changed must list every repository-relative path you changed or be an empty array; the orchestrator measures independently and disagreement is recorded as an error.
completion_contract.rule: Your final message must be ONE JSON object matching the handoff schema -- no prose around it.

honesty_note: Every status field here states what exists today. Anything planned is labelled planned and must not be relied on.

modes.note: Quaestor has two orchestration modes. Read the one you are in before you decide how to answer: they have DIFFERENT reply contracts.

program.summary: The state-machine mode: a program with acceptance criteria, lanes, at-most-one execution per dispatch identity, and reconciliation of claims against independently measured evidence.

modes.relationship: Relay Mode does not run through Program Mode. The two share the same substrate: authority, evidence, repository observation and classification.

maturity.chatgpt-web: LIVE_END_TO_END_QUALIFIED, not PRODUCT_SUPPORTED: there is no browser extension, no native messaging host, no installer and no signed distribution. The only browser path today is CDP against a browser the operator started themselves.

relay.not_yet_relay_endpoints: Claude Code and Codex are not relay endpoints in this build. They are reachable in Program Mode; they cannot be named to `relay start`.
relay.reply_contract: Natural prose. The completion_contract below does NOT apply in Relay Mode -- a bare JSON handoff object is forwarded to the counterpart as prose and helps nobody.
relay.summary: A selected Orchestrator and a selected Execution Agent hold one continuous conversation; Quaestor carries every turn, observes the repository independently, and gates effects.

name: Quaestor
protocol_version_policy: Major versions are refused, not best-effort parsed. An unknown major means stop and renegotiate, never guess.
summary: AI orchestration platform: governed delegation of work to Execution Agents with independent evidence instead of self-reported success.

core_service.note: an authenticated loopback boundary. It exposes NAMED operations only -- there is no execute, no file read or write, and no path parameter. A client token is scoped to named projects and cannot reach another.

notes: relay doctor measures readiness: it builds and probes both endpoints and reports what is missing, but starts no conversation.
The scripted endpoint kind `fake` exists for the control suite and is REFUSED by `relay start`: a relay reporting a finished conversation no model took part in would look exactly like a real one.
